entities.text: Tadoor Rajamma vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This writ petition is filed questioning the action of the respondent Nos.2 and 3 in trying to give second time marking for another 7 feet against the petitioner's H.Nos.3-39, 3-40, 3-45, 3-46 and 3-47 to an extent of 2551.00 sq. feet RCC and an extent of 999.00 sq. feet non-RCC and total an extent of 781.11 sq. yards equivalent to 653.08 sq. meters as illegal and arbitrary.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings.
3.

Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is owner and possessor of the subject lands having purchased the same from the erstwhile owners and after purchase, he has demolished the SK, J structures towards southern side to an extent of 7 feet width for 50 feet road i.e, Wanaparthy to Kollapur road.

He submits that the respondent Nos.2 and 3 along with their staff are interfering with the subject properties of the petitioner by making markings over the walls under the guise of road widening and requested to direct the respondent Nos.2 and 3 not to dispossess the petitioner from the subject properties.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue has produced a letter No.Supdt/R&B/
Wnp/W.P.No. of 2025 dated 11.04.2025 and stated that the Roads and Buildings Department has not taken up the dismantling work in the petitioner's property and also not competent to issue any notice to the petitioner as per the Land Acquisition Act and hence, the respondent Nos.2 and 3 are not involved in demolition process in the petitioner's properties.
SK, J 5.
In view of the aforesaid letter submitted by the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings, the cause in the writ petition does not survive.
6. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is closed.

If the respondents want to acquire the subject properties of the petitioners, they have to follow due procedure as contemplated under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
